text:
Please call your vet, an emergency vet, or an animal poison control hotline right now, before doing anything else. Heavy drooling after chewing a pothos is a sign your dog needs professional advice quickly. Pothos is on our list of plants that are not pet-safe.

Tell them your dog's size, what was chewed (pothos) and roughly how much, and when it happened. Follow their instructions, and don't try to make your dog vomit unless they tell you to. Once your dog is taken care of, I'm happy to help with anything on the Leafy side, such as moving the plant out of reach or getting care advice from a Plant Care Specialist.
